meta.name: google-cloud-waf-sustainability
meta.description: Generates sustainability-focused guidance for Google Cloud workloads based on the design principles and recommendations in the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework (WAF). Use this skill to evaluate a workload, identify environmental impact requirements, and provide actionable recommendations to build, deploy, and manage the workload sustainably in Google Cloud.

copy.tagline: 评估云工作负载并给出可持续性优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在Google Cloud上运行工作负载并希望降低环境影响
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate cloud workloads and provide sustainability optimization recommendations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run workloads on Google Cloud and want to reduce environmental impact

howto.what: Claude 会根据 Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework 的可持续性支柱，评估你的工作负载，识别环境影响需求，并提供可操作的建议，帮助你在 Google Cloud 中可持续地构建、部署和管理工作负载。
howto.when: 当你询问如何减少 Google Cloud 工作负载的碳足迹，或要求评估工作负载的可持续性时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估我的 GKE 集群的可持续性。
say.note: Claude 会询问工作负载细节并给出优化建议。

say.text: 如何选择低碳区域的 Google Cloud 服务？
say.note: Claude 会解释区域选择策略并推荐工具。

howto.what_en: Claude evaluates your Google Cloud workload based on the Sustainability pillar of the Well-Architected Framework, identifies environmental impact requirements, and provides actionable recommendations to build, deploy, and manage workloads sustainably.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about reducing carbon footprint of Google Cloud workloads or request a sustainability assessment.

say_en.text: Assess the sustainability of my GKE cluster.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about workload details and give optimization tips.

say_en.text: How to choose low-carbon regions for Google Cloud services?
say_en.note: Claude explains region selection strategy and recommends tools.
